sec.t: Use only this email for work
sec.p:
Every email you send on behalf of Haritt Group goes from pulkit.soni@haritt.com. Please do not use any personal email ID for company work.
All conversations with clients, partners, vendors and the team happen on this ID, so the company has a full record.
Share only this ID on documents, proposals, LinkedIn and anywhere you represent Haritt Group.

Emails to pulkit.soni@haritt.com arrive straight in your Gmail. Nothing new to open.
Gmail app on your phone: Settings > your account > **Notifications: All**.
Please check and reply quickly, the same day at the latest.

Receiving already works. To also send and reply, do a one-time setup in Gmail on a laptop (about 10 minutes).
Open the step-by-step guide below. It has pictures for every step.
The password for the setup comes to you separately as a WhatsApp message from the team.

note: Please reply to this email once you get it, so we know it is working.

subject: Yash, welcome to Haritt · A note from Harsh Goyal, Founder
label: From the Founder
title: Welcome to Haritt, Yash
intro:
Hi Yash,

I'm Harsh, Founder of Haritt Group. I wanted to write to you myself. Welcome to the Haritt family. I'm really glad you are now part of this journey, and congratulations on completing this step.

We meet **today at 9:00 PM** on WhatsApp video. I hope you have received the invite, and I look forward to seeing you there.

Before the meeting, please take some time to explore **Haritt Group and our ventures**. Understand the mission and vision of each, what they do and who they serve. This will help us have a real discussion tonight.

sec.p:
**[haritt.com](https://haritt.com)** · Haritt Group, our parent company. Our mission, vision, values and how we work.
**[developers.haritt.com](https://developers.haritt.com)** · Haritt Developers, our business solutions venture. How we help businesses grow, end to end.
**[thehvverse.com](https://thehvverse.com)** · HV Verse, our student venture. Our apps and products that help students plan, learn and grow.

The mission and vision of each venture, in your own words
What problem each one solves, and for whom
Where you see yourself adding the most value
Anything you like, anything you would improve, and your questions

note: Bring your notes tonight. There are no wrong answers. I want to hear how you see Haritt.

subject: Yash, your first task · Explore all 3 Haritt websites deeply
label: Your first task
title: Your task for the next few days
intro:
Hi Yash,

Great to have you with us. Your first task for the next 4 days is simple, but very important: **go through all three of our websites deeply**. Every page, every product and every service.
info:
Task: Explore and review all 3 websites
Time: Next 4 days
Share with: Harsh Goyal

sec.p:
**[haritt.com](https://haritt.com)** · Haritt Group. Our story, mission, vision and ventures.
**[developers.haritt.com](https://developers.haritt.com)** · Haritt Developers. Every service, how we work and how we help businesses.
**[thehvverse.com](https://thehvverse.com)** · HV Verse. Every app (HV Reset, HV Hunt, HV Assess). Try them like a student would.

**As a team member.** Understand what we do, who we serve, and how each product and service works.
**As a normal visitor.** Is everything clear and easy? Is anything confusing, broken, slow or missing? Would you trust it and take the next step?

A short summary of each venture, in your own words
What you liked the most
Anything confusing, broken or missing, with the page link and a screenshot
Your ideas to make each website clearer and better

note: Take your time and go deep. This is the best way to understand Haritt from the inside. Reply to this email with your notes.
